<header class="ws-head"><span class="ws-kicker">Day 1 · Module 1 · fills Sheet 1</span><h2>From journey to capabilities</h2><p class="ws-carries">What had to exist for this moment to work — and where does our version of the journey break?</p></header>
<h3>On the canvas</h3><section class="ws-canvas"><img src="country-canvas/page-2.png" alt="Country Canvas Sheet 1: Our journey and where it breaks"/><div><h3>Sheet 1 · Our journey and where it breaks</h3><ol class="ws-parts"><li><span class="ws-min">8 min</span><b>Our use case</b>A child vaccinated in ___ should be able to ___ in ___.</li><li><span class="ws-min">25 min</span><b>The journey</b>Four touchpoints, each rated Works, Partly or Breaks for your country today; a ★ where it breaks hardest.</li><li><span class="ws-min">7 min</span><b>The capabilities this journey needs</b>Seven capabilities, ticked Needed, with the touchpoints that use them; they carry onto Sheet 2.</li></ol><p class="ws-links"><a href="country-canvas.html">The whole canvas</a><a href="country-canvas-a3.docx">Word file (A3)</a><a href="country-canvas-a3.pdf">PDF</a></p></div></section>
<h3>Where it meets the journey</h3><div class="ws-cards"><div class="ws-card"><a class="ws-step" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J1/">J1</a><b>An Onesan baby is born in Taifafeki</b><p><span class="ws-t">What the system does</span>Hospital immunization record; one DVC per birth dose, signed by Taifafeki's document signer.</p><p><span class="ws-p">Policy question</span>Which child, which record and which border would your country's use case cover?</p></div><div class="ws-card"><a class="ws-step" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J3a/">J3a</a><b>The clinic confirms the cards are genuine</b><p><span class="ws-t">What the system does</span>Signature checked offline against the cached GDHCN trust list.</p><p><span class="ws-p">Policy question</span>What must be true before a nurse trusts a vaccination record she did not create?</p></div></div>
<p class="ws-also">Also draws on <span title="Where does your own journey break first: is there a stage where no national system knows the child exists?"><a class="ws-step draws" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J2a/">J2a</a></span><span title="For a child born abroad, does each touchpoint in your country work, partly work, or break today?"><a class="ws-step draws" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J2b/">J2b</a></span><span title="Does a dose given abroad count toward your national schedule?"><a class="ws-step draws" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J3b/">J3b</a></span><span title="Should the family or the state decide when a child's record is shared?"><a class="ws-step draws" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J4.0b/">J4.0b</a></span><span title="Is continuity of the record across a border the end point of your use case?"><a class="ws-step draws" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J4.1/">J4.1</a></span></p>
<h3>Questions for the table</h3><ul class="ws-qs"><li><a class="ws-step" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J1/">J1</a><span>Write your country’s use-case statement: “A child vaccinated in ___ should be able to ___ in ___.”</span></li><li><a class="ws-step" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J3a/">J3a</a><span>What must be true for this nurse to trust a record she did not create?</span></li></ul>
<h3>Terms you will hear</h3><div class="ws-terms"><a href="glossary.html#term-electronic-immunization-registry" title="Records each person's doses. Often the first working part of a lifelong record.">Electronic immunization registry</a><a href="glossary.html#term-client-registry" title="The Client Registry is the national authoritative source of health-specific person identity. It is the foundational health-sector component that maintains a unique, verifiable identity record for every person who accesses or is eligible to access health services within a jurisdiction.">Client Registry</a><a href="glossary.html#term-facility-workforce-and-product-registries" title="Authoritative lists of health facilities, health workers, and products such as vaccines and their batches.">Facility, workforce and product registries</a><a href="glossary.html#term-dose-number-and-series" title="Which dose this is, out of how many in the schedule. Needed to work out what is due next.">Dose number and series</a><a href="glossary.html#term-batch-number" title="Identifies the production batch of a vaccine. Needed for recalls and safety checks.">Batch number</a><a href="glossary.html#term-verifiable-credential" title="A digitally signed statement, such as a vaccination record, that anyone can check is genuine and unaltered.">Verifiable credential</a><a href="glossary.html#term-digital-signature" title="A cryptographic seal made with the issuer's private key. Verifiers check it with the matching public key.">Digital signature</a><a href="glossary.html#term-public-key-infrastructure" title="The keys, certificates and rules that make digital signatures trustworthy.">Public key infrastructure</a><a href="glossary.html#term-issuer-holder-verifier" title="The three roles: who signs the credential, who keeps it, and who checks it.">Issuer · holder · verifier</a><a href="glossary.html#term-health-certificate-identifier" title="The unique ID of an issued certificate.">Health certificate identifier</a><a href="glossary.html#term-international-certificate-of-vaccination-or-prophylaxis" title="The &quot;yellow card&quot;. The digital ICVP is its signed, verifiable form.">International Certificate of Vaccination or Prophylaxis</a><a href="glossary.html#term-consent" title="A person's permission for their data to be used or shared. Rules for minors and dependants differ by country.">Consent</a><a href="glossary.html#term-trust-list" title="A published list of keys accepted as valid issuers. The GDHCN shares these between countries.">Trust list</a><a href="glossary.html#term-global-digital-health-certification-network" title="WHO Global Digital Health Certification Network. A trust network so countries can verify each other's health documents. Countries onboard per use case.">Global Digital Health Certification Network</a><a href="glossary.html#term-trust-anchor" title="The national authority whose key vouches for the health sector's signers.">Trust anchor</a></div>
